en:sat.definition: sit eyleminin geçmiş zamana çekimlenmiş hali. (sit - sat - sit)
en:sat.enDefinition: To be in a position in which the upper body is upright and supported by the buttocks. · To move oneself into such a position. · To occupy a given position. · To remain in a state of repose; to rest; to abide; to rest in any position or condition.

en:wound.enDefinition: An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body. · A hurt to a person's feelings, reputation, prospects, etc. · An injury to a person by which the skin is divided or its continuity broken.
en:wound.deDefinition: körperliche Verletzung · die Kränkung, die Beleidigung

en:traffic.enDefinition: pedestrians or vehicles on roads or on the air
en:traffic.pairedSense: pedestrians or vehicles on roads or on the air

en:courage.enDefinition: The quality of being confident, not afraid or easily intimidated, but without being incautious or inconsiderate. · The ability to overcome one's fear, do or live things which one finds frightening. · The ability to maintain one's will or intent despite either the experience of fear, frailty, or frustration; or the occurrence of adversity, difficulty, defeat or reversal; moral fortitude.

en:hunt.enDefinition: To find or search for an animal in the wild with the intention of killing the animal for its meat or for sport. · To try to find something; search (for). · To drive; to chase; with down, from, away, etc. · To use or manage (dogs, horses, etc.) in hunting.

en:rat.enDefinition: Any of the numerous members of several rodent families that usually have short limbs, a pointy snout, a long, hairless tail, and a body length greater than about 12 cm, or 5 inches. · A medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus. · A person who is known for betrayal. · An informant or snitch.
en:rat.deDefinition: Nagetier; Ratte · hinterhältiger Mensch; Ratte · Informant; Ratte

en:terms.enDefinition: one of the addends in a sum or in another mathematical operation
en:terms.pairedSense: one of the addends in a sum or in another mathematical operation

en:checking.enDefinition: An inspection or examination. · A control; a limit or stop. · A situation in which the king is directly threatened by an opposing piece. · A mark (especially a checkmark: ✓) used as an indicator.

en:disease.enDefinition: An abnormal condition of a human, animal or plant that causes discomfort or dysfunction; distinct from injury insofar as the latter is usually instantaneously acquired. · Any abnormal or harmful condition, as of society, people's attitudes, way of living etc. · A lack of ease; uneasiness; trouble; vexation; disquiet.

en:managed.enDefinition: To direct or be in charge of. · To handle or control (a situation, job). · To handle with skill, wield (a tool, weapon etc.). · To succeed at an attempt in spite of difficulty.
en:managed.deDefinition: bewältigen, schaffen · organisieren, verwalten · führen, leiten

en:winner.enDefinition: One who has won or often wins. · A point or goal that wins a competition.

en:appointment.definition: randevu · iş, konum · bir işe alınmış veya işyerindeki bir bir mevkiye atanmış kişi · mobilya
en:appointment.enDefinition: The act of appointing a person to hold an office or to have a position of trust. · The state of being appointed to a service or office; an office to which one is appointed. · A stipulation; an agreement; the act of fixing by mutual agreement. · An arrangement between people to meet; an engagement.
en:appointment.deDefinition: Arzttermin · Posten, Stelle, Anstellung · Termin, Verabredung · Ernennung

en:crack.enDefinition: To form cracks. · To break apart under force, stress, or pressure. · To become debilitated by psychological pressure. · To break down or yield, especially under interrogation or torture.

en:threat.enDefinition: An expression of intent to injure or punish another. · An indication of potential or imminent danger. · A person or object that is regarded as a danger; a menace.

en:physical.enDefinition: Pertaining to the world as understood through the senses rather than the mind, having to do with the material world. · In accordance with the laws of nature; now specifically, pertaining to physics. · Denoting a map showing natural features of the landscape (compare political). · Having to do with the body as opposed to the mind; corporeal, bodily.

en:source.definition: kaynak, göz, bulak, eşme, göze, kaynarca, memba, pınar · kaynak
en:source.enDefinition: The person, place, or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired. · Spring; fountainhead; wellhead; any collection of water on or under the surface of the ground in which a stream originates. · A reporter's informant. · Source code.

en:chose.enDefinition: To pick; to make the choice of; to select. · To elect. · To decide to act in a certain way. · To prefer; to wish; to desire.

en:healthy.enDefinition: Enjoying good health; free from disease or disorder. · Conducive to health. · Evincing health. · Significant, hefty; beneficial.

en:carl.enDefinition: A rude, rustic man; a churl.

en:victory.enDefinition: The condition or state of having won a battle or competition, or having succeeded in an effort; (countable) an instance of this. · Alternative letter-case form of Victory (“(uncountable) the Roman goddess of victory, the counterpart of the Greek goddess Nike; also (countable), an artistic depiction of her, chiefly as a winged woman”).

en:rick.enDefinition: Straw, hay etc. stored in a stack for winter fodder, commonly protected with thatch. · A stack of wood, especially cut to a regular length; also used as a measure of wood, typically four by eight feet.

en:stood.enDefinition: To support oneself on the feet in an erect position. · To rise to one’s feet; to stand up. · To remain motionless. · To be placed in an upright or vertical orientation.
en:stood.deDefinition: stehen, aufstehen · jemandem bedingungslos unterstützen; loyal bleiben · (eine bestimmte) Größe, Höhe haben (the building stands 20 m high; das Gebäude hat eine Höhe von 20 m) · (einen bestimmten) Messwert aufweisen (Aktien, Thermometer, Wasserstand etc.)

en:kicked.enDefinition: strike with or raise the foot or leg
en:kicked.pairedSense: strike with or raise the foot or leg

en:palace.enDefinition: Official residence of a head of state or other dignitary, especially in a monarchical or imperial governmental system. · A large and lavishly ornate residence. · A large, ornate public building used for entertainment or exhibitions.
en:palace.deDefinition: ein besonders aufwendig ausgestattetes Gebäude; Palast · Pfalz (Sitz des Königs/ der Königin), Fürstenhaus

en:below.enDefinition: In or to a lower place. · On or to a lower storey. · On or to a lower deck, especially as relative to the main deck. · Later in the same text.

en:shopping.enDefinition: An establishment that sells goods or services to the public; originally only a physical location, but now a virtual establishment as well. · A place where things are manufactured or crafted; a workshop. · A large garage where vehicle mechanics work. · Workplace; office. Used mainly in expressions such as shop talk, closed shop and shop floor.
en:shopping.deDefinition: Einkauf, Einkaufen · Einkäufe machen, Shopping, Shoppen

en:neighborhood.enDefinition: topology: set containing an open set which contains some specified point
en:neighborhood.pairedSense: topology: set containing an open set which contains some specified point

en:march.enDefinition: A formal, rhythmic way of walking, used especially by soldiers, by bands, and in ceremonies. · A journey so walked. · A political rally or parade. · Any song in the genre of music written for marching (see Wikipedia's article on this type of music)

en:lips.enDefinition: Either of the two fleshy protrusions around the opening of the mouth. · A part of the body that resembles a lip, such as the edge of a wound or the labia. · The projecting rim of an open container or a bell, etc.; a short open spout. · Backtalk; verbal impertinence.
en:lips.deDefinition: Lippe · Ausguss, Schnabel (einer Kanne) · Lefze · Rand einer Tasse oder Kraters

en:midnight.enDefinition: The middle of the night: the sixth temporal hour, equidistant between sunset and sunrise. · Twelve o'clock at night exactly. · Synonym of boxcars (“a pair of sixes”).

en:piss.enDefinition: Urine. · The act of urinating. · Alcoholic beverage, especially of inferior quality. · An intensifier.

en:advantage.definition: çıkar · yarar, fayda, avantaj, üstünlük, kâr, kazanç
en:advantage.enDefinition: Any condition, circumstance, opportunity or means, particularly favorable or chance to success, or to any desired end. · Superiority of state, or that which gives it; benefit; gain; profit · The score where one player wins a point after deuce but needs the next to carry the game. · The continuation of the game after a foul against the attacking team, because the attacking team are in an advantageous position.

en:pure.definition: saf; temiz; katıksız; pür; sade; lekesiz.
en:pure.enDefinition: Free of flaws or imperfections; unsullied. · Free of foreign material or pollutants. · Free of immoral behavior or qualities; clean. · Mere; that and that only.

en:india.enDefinition: Alternative letter-case form of India from the NATO/ICAO Phonetic Alphabet.

en:aside.enDefinition: An incidental remark to a person next to one made discreetly but not in private, audible only to that person. · A brief comment by a character addressing the audience, unheard by other characters. · A minor related mention, an afterthought.

en:jerk.enDefinition: quick, often unpleasant tug or shake
en:jerk.pairedSense: quick, often unpleasant tug or shake

en:mail.enDefinition: A bag or wallet. · A bag containing letters to be delivered by post. · The (physical) material conveyed by the postal service. · The letters, parcels, etc. delivered to a particular address or person.
en:mail.deDefinition: durch Dritte beförderte Schriftstücke oder Pakete · das befördernde (staatliche) Unternehmen · geschmeidige Panzerung aus Metallringen

en:dawn.enDefinition: To begin to brighten with daylight. · To start to appear or become obvious. · To begin to give promise; to begin to appear or to expand.

en:effect.enDefinition: The result or outcome of a cause. · Impression left on the mind; sensation produced. · Execution; performance; realization; operation. · The state of being binding and enforceable, as in a rule, policy, or law.

en:spell.enDefinition: Words or a formula supposed to have magical powers. · A magical effect or influence induced by an incantation or formula.
en:spell.deDefinition: ein Spruch oder Wort, die einen Zauber oder Fluch bewirken sollen; Zauberformel, Zauberspruch · der Zustand, wenn etwas oder jemand von einem Zauber, von Magie beeinflusst (verzaubert) ist · unwiderstehliche, fesselnde Faszination oder Anziehung hervorgerufen von einer Person oder einer Sache

en:freak.enDefinition: Someone or something that is markedly unusual or unpredictable. · A person who is extremely abnormal in appearance, social behavior, sexual orientation, gender identity, or business practices; an oddball, a unique person, originally in a displeasing or alienating way. · A hippie. · A drug addict.
en:freak.deDefinition: sehr ungewöhnliche und unerwartete oder befremdliche Sache oder Person · extrem an etwas interessierte oder davon besessene Person

en:screwed.enDefinition: Beset with unfortunate circumstances that seem difficult or impossible to overcome; in imminent danger.

en:enemies.enDefinition: Someone who is hostile to, feels hatred towards, opposes the interests of, or intends injury to someone else. · A hostile force or nation; a fighting member of such a force or nation. · Something harmful or threatening to another · Of, by, relating to, or belonging to an enemy.

en:awake.deDefinition: prädikativ; nie vor einem Substantiv · wach, nicht schlafend; wachsam · (to be awake to something) sich (einer Sache) bewusst sein

en:vacation.enDefinition: An extended trip or journey away from home for rest or pleasure. · An extended period of leisure time away from work or school. · A period during which official activity or business is formally suspended; an official holiday from university, law courts etc. · The act of vacating something; moving out.
en:vacation.deDefinition: Ferien · vorlesungsfreie Zeit an Hochschulen · Zeitraum, in dem eine Einrichtung oder Betrieb geschlossen ist; Betriebsferien · eine Atempause oder eine Zeit der Ruhepause von etwas

en:violence.enDefinition: Extreme force. · Physical action which causes destruction, harm, pain, or suffering. · Widespread fighting. · A perceived injustice, especially in the context of social justice.

en:leo.enDefinition: Clipping of leotard. · A fairy chess piece which moves analogously to the xiangqi cannon and queen, moving either orthogonally or diagonally and must hop over a piece of either side to capture.

en:grandmother.definition: büyük anne, nine, nene, anneanne · babaanne
en:grandmother.enDefinition: A mother of someone's parent. · A female ancestor or progenitor. · In Amazonian shamanism and related contexts, a reverential name for the ayahuasca vine or brew, symbolizing its role as a wise, guiding spirit.

en:modern.definition: çağdaş, çağcıl, uygarca, asri, muasır, modern
en:modern.enDefinition: Pertaining to a current or recent time and style; not ancient. · Pertaining to the modern period (c.1800 to contemporary times), particularly in academic historiography.

en:firm.enDefinition: A business partnership; the name under which it trades. · A business enterprise, however organized. · A criminal gang, especially based around football hooliganism.

en:prime.definition: başlıca; en önemli; esas; temel; en uygun; en olası · mükemmel; en iyi kalite · asal (sayı)
en:prime.enDefinition: First in importance, degree, or rank. · First in time, order, or sequence. · First in excellence, quality, or value. · Having exactly two integral factors: itself and unity (1 in the case of integers).

en:heh.enDefinition: The fifth letter of many Semitic alphabets (Phoenician 𐤄, Aramaic 𐡄, Hebrew ה, Syriac ܗ, Arabic ه, and others).

en:touched.enDefinition: Emotionally moved (by), made to feel emotion (by). · Slightly mentally deficient; touched in the head.

en:talent.enDefinition: A marked natural ability or skill. · People of talent, viewed collectively; a talented person. · One, especially a woman, from a particular place or area, judged by their attractiveness.

en:whore.enDefinition: Synonym of prostitute: a person (especially a woman) who offers sexual services for payment. · A person who is sexually promiscuous; a slut. · A person who is unscrupulous, especially one who compromises their principles for gain. · A person who will violate behavioral standards to achieve something desired.

en:piano.enDefinition: A percussive keyboard musical instrument, usually ranging over seven octaves, with white and black colored keys, played by pressing these keys, causing hammers to strike strings.

en:license.enDefinition: A legal document giving official permission to do something; a permit. · The legal terms under which a person is allowed to use a product, especially software. · Freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behaviour or speech). · Excessive freedom; lack of due restraint.
en:license.deDefinition: Lizenz, Konzession · Führerschein · Zügellosigkeit, Unzüchtigkeit · Erlaubnis, Bewilligung

en:cooking.enDefinition: The process of preparing food by using heat. · One's ability to prepare food; cookery. · The style or genre of food preparation. · The cheapest available beer for sale in a public house.

en:honour.enDefinition: British, Canadian, Commonwealth, and Ireland standard spelling of honor.

en:concern.enDefinition: That which affects one’s welfare or happiness. A matter of interest to someone. · The placement of interest or worry on a subject. · A worry; a sense that something may be wrong; an identification of a possible problem. · The expression of solicitude, anxiety, or compassion toward a thing or person.

en:moves.enDefinition: To change place or posture; to go, in any manner, from one place or position to another. · To act; to take action; to begin to act · To change residence, for example from one house, town, or state, to another; to go and live at another place; similarly to change the location of another establishment such as a business. See also move out and move in. · To transport (an item) as part of changing residences.
en:moves.deDefinition: 3. Person Singular Indikativ Präsens Aktiv des Verbs move

en:available.enDefinition: Such as one may avail oneself of; capable of being used for the accomplishment of a purpose. · Readily obtainable. · Valid. · Free to meet someone, speak on the telephone, enter a romantic relationship, or the like.

en:factory.enDefinition: A building or other place where manufacturing takes place. · A police station. · A device or process that produces or manufactures something. · A factory farm.
en:factory.deDefinition: die Fabrik, das Werk, der Betrieb

en:value.enDefinition: ideal accepted by some individual or group
en:value.pairedSense: ideal accepted by some individual or group

en:central.enDefinition: Being in the centre. · Having or containing the centre of something. · Being very important, or key to something. · Exerting its action towards the peripheral organs.

en:union.enDefinition: The act of uniting or joining two or more things into one. · The state of being united or joined; a state of unity or harmony. · Something united, or made one; something formed by a combination or coalition of parts or members; a confederation; a consolidated body; a league. · A trade union; a workers' union.
en:union.deDefinition: Zusammenschluss von Arbeitern/Angestellten, Interessenvertretung der Angestellten; Gewerkschaft · Vereinigungsmenge

en:mirror.enDefinition: A smooth surface, usually made of glass with reflective material painted on the underside, that reflects light so as to give an image of what is in front of it. · An object, person, or event that reflects or gives a picture of another. · A website or server that contains replicated data from another site. · A mirror carp.

en:studio.enDefinition: An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works. · An establishment where an art is taught. · A place where radio or television programs, records or films are made. · A company or organization that makes films, records or other artistic works.

en:media.enDefinition: The middle layer of the wall of a blood vessel or lymph vessel which is composed of connective and muscular tissue. · One of the major veins of the insect wing, between the radius and the cubitus. · An ant specialized as a forager in a leaf-cutter ant colony.

en:taxi.enDefinition: A vehicle that may be hired for single journeys by members of the public, particularly one with an automated meter to calculate the fare. · The movement of an aircraft across an airport's surface under its own power; a phase of aircraft operation involving this movement. · Synonym of shared taxi.
en:taxi.deDefinition: Mietfahrzeug mit Chauffeur für eine kürzere Zeit; Taxi

en:dies.deDefinition: sterben · umkommen · versterben · ums Leben kommen

en:iron.enDefinition: A common, inexpensive metal, silvery grey when untarnished, that rusts, is attracted by magnets, and is used in making steel: a chemical element having atomic number 26 and symbol Fe. · Any material, not a steel, predominantly made of elemental iron. · A tool or appliance made of metal, which is heated and then used to transfer heat to something else; most often a thick piece of metal fitted with a handle and having a flat, roughly triangular bottom, which is heated and used to press wrinkles from clothing, and now usually containing an electrical heating apparatus. · Any of several other tools traditionally made of wrought iron, now usually of steel.

en:desire.enDefinition: To want; to wish for earnestly. · To put a request to (someone); to entreat. · To want emotionally or sexually. · To express a wish for; to entreat; to request.

en:rob.enDefinition: To steal from, especially using force or violence. · To deprive of, or withhold from, unjustly or injuriously; to defraud. · To deprive (of). · To burgle.
en:rob.deDefinition: einer Person oder einer Institution (Bank, Laden) unerlaubt und meist gewaltsam Geld oder Eigentum wegnehmen: berauben · jemandem Chancen, Positionen, Vorstellungen und anderes entziehen: jemanden einer Sache berauben · einen Raub begehen: rauben

en:claire.enDefinition: A small enclosed pond used for gathering and greening oysters.

en:songs.enDefinition: A musical composition with lyrics for voice or voices, performed by singing. · Any musical composition. · Poetical composition; poetry; verse. · The act or art of singing.
en:songs.deDefinition: das Lied, das Gesangstück/Gesangsstück, der Gesang, der Sang · musikalischer Ton eines Tieres, dessen Stimme die Menschen melodiös finden, das Zirpen, der Vogelgesang, Walgesang · etwas, das nur ein bisschen kostet · das Musikstück

en:washington.enDefinition: Synonym of agawan base (a team game)

en:monkey.enDefinition: A member of the clade Simiiformes other than those in the clade Hominoidea containing apes, generally (but not universally) distinguished by small size, tails, and cheek pouches. · Any simian, including humans. · Any simian primate other than hominids; any monkey or ape. · A naughty or mischievous person, especially a child.

en:pride.enDefinition: quality or state of being proud; inordinate self-esteem; an unreasonable conceit of one's own superiority in talents, beauty, wealth, rank etc.
en:pride.pairedSense: quality or state of being proud; inordinate self-esteem; an unreasonable conceit of one's own superiority in talents, beauty, wealth, rank etc.

en:miracle.enDefinition: An event that appears inexplicable by the laws of nature and so is held to be supernatural in origin. · A fortunate outcome that prevails despite overwhelming odds against it. · An awesome and exceptional example of something.

en:swim.enDefinition: To move through the water, without touching the bottom; to propel oneself in water by natural means. · To become immersed in, or as if in, or flooded with, or as if with, a liquid. · To move around freely because of excess space. · To traverse (a specific body of water, or a specific distance) by swimming; or, to use a specific swimming stroke; or, to compete in a specific swimming event.
en:swim.deDefinition: sich auf oder in einer Flüssigkeit (aus eigener Kraft) fortbewegen; schwimmen · ins Wasser tauchen/gehen, um sich zu reinigen oder zu erfrischen; baden · auf einem Medium treiben; nicht untergehen; schweben · sich dem Schwimmen ähnlich fortbewegen; treiben, gleiten

en:burned.enDefinition: Damaged or consumed by heat, fire, oxidation, or similar process.

en:hook.enDefinition: A rod bent into a curved shape, typically with one end free and the other end secured to a rope or other attachment. · A barbed metal hook used for fishing; a fishhook. · Any of various hook-shaped agricultural implements such as a billhook. · The curved needle used in the art of crochet.
en:hook.deDefinition: ein gebogenes Gerät aus einem harten Stoff (oft Metall), zum Fangen oder Halten; der Haken · der Haken · der Angelhaken, der Haken

en:beating.enDefinition: The action by which someone or something is beaten. · A heavy defeat or setback. · The pulsation of the heart.

en:protection.enDefinition: The process of keeping (something or someone) safe. · The state of being safe. · A means of keeping or remaining safe. · A means, such as a condom, of preventing pregnancy or sexually transmitted disease.

en:treatment.enDefinition: The process or manner of treating someone or something. · Medical care for an illness or injury. · The use of a substance or process to preserve or give particular properties to something. · A treatise; a formal written description or characterization of a subject.
